en: Sasha, well done tonight.
You're the only guy this year to make
the semifinals or better in all four majors,
including the win in Roland Garros
and the finals in Wimbledon.
Is your mentality going
into a major different than it is going
to any other event?
Yes and no.
I think, you know,
you saw that in the first two rounds
when I really didn't play well.
I can rely
on my physicality a bit more in majors
than I can other tournaments, you know,
and in other tournaments I would
have been out at the first round,
but here I can fight back and play best
of five, play for four and a half hours
and somehow win the match
and somehow get into the tournament
and then, you know,
I start playing better throughout
the tournament and yeah,
definitely happy to be in a semi-finals here.
But of course, I want to I want to go further.
A
a big talking point this year
has been these late night finishes.
You've had a couple.
You had one that finished at 2:15 a.m.
Can you take us through the routine
after that?
When you're done at 2:15,
do you have a full meal?
What time do you actually get to bed?
Yeah.
I mean, you go to the ice bath,
you have a meal, you talk to the press,
which you're part
of, and unfortunately I hate doing,
so, but that's that's okay.
And then afterwards, yeah,
you you get some treatment done
and you go to bed.
I mean, I went to bed as late as 6:45 a.m.
in the last in the last week.
So, I'm kind of a bit jetlagged.
I feel like I'm playing the Australian Open
in New York right now.
But, as long as I'm still here,
as long as I'm in the semi-finals,
that's that's all that matters.
You're going
to get a proper bedtime tonight.
Finally, you're in one of the best cities
in the world.
You're here every other night,
but the other nights,
are you one to go out to dinners in the city
and check out all the things
that New York has to offer?
I watched I watched Shelton Alcaraz until
last night.
I did not go to bed.
I was up late.
I was watching TV cuz I was sleeping
in until 1:00 p.m.
Anyway, so credit to Ben.
He played an unbelievable match.
And tomorrow after tomorrow,
it's going to be, I think,
a fun semi-final between two Americans.
Yeah, we're excited for both.
Congratulations tonight
into the semi-finals.
Sasha Zverev.
